title: PHD-Hand: A Printable Humanoid Dexterous Hand with Linkage-Driven 3-DOA Digits
abstract: arXiv:2610.29030v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Currently, dexterous humanoid robot hands are widely considered the final hardware bottleneck that hampers generalist robots from physically assisting people at home and work. As conventional tendon-driven designs suffer from high cost, demanding maintenance, poor reliability, and short durability, alternative linkage-driven designs have increasingly gained attention. Despite their potential to avoid the weaknesses of tendon-driven hands, integrating multiple degrees of actuation (DOA) in a single digit with linkage drivetrains is a challenge for design and fabrication. Only a few studies have managed to present functional humanoid hands that are completely linkage-driven and have at least three DOAs per digit without compromising actuator placement and other design preferences. translated_title: PHD-Hand：一种可打印的、具有连杆驱动3驱动自由度手指的人形灵巧手
translated_abstract: 目前，灵巧人形机器人手被广泛认为是阻碍通用机器人在家庭和工作场所为人们提供物理协助的最后硬件瓶颈。由于传统的腱驱动设计存在成本高、维护要求苛刻、可靠性差和耐用性短等缺陷，替代性的连杆驱动设计日益受到关注。尽管连杆驱动有潜力规避腱驱动手的弱点，但在单根手指中通过连杆传动集成多个驱动自由度（DOA）对设计和制造而言是一项挑战。迄今仅有少数研究能够在不牺牲驱动器布置和其他设计偏好的前提下，实现完全连杆驱动且每根手指至少具有三个驱动自由度的功能性人形手。本工作提出了一种新型连杆驱动手，其特色在于采用了一种独特的柔性铰链。配合由弹簧钢制成的弹性驱动杆，该连杆传动系统……
tldr: 该论文提出PHD-Hand，一种可3D打印的人形灵巧手，通过独特的柔性铰链与弹簧钢弹性驱动杆实现每根手指3个驱动自由度的全连杆驱动设计，从而克服了传统腱驱动手成本高、维护难、可靠性差的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PHD-Hand, a printable humanoid dexterous hand that achieves fully linkage-driven 3-DOA digits through a unique flexure hinge and spring-steel elastic drive rods, overcoming the high cost, demanding maintenance, and poor reliability of conventional tendon-driven designs.
